messages:
alejandra: Quick sync — pricing page experiment plan for next week. Goal: tighten tier names, refresh FAQ with use-case first answers, and pilot a smaller calculator on /pricing. want to avoid a big launch, more of staged posts + a webinar teaser.

rachel: love it. can we scope the FAQ edits to top 6 Qs and add one flow for dedicated vs private? short bullets only.

sam: suggested KPI: conversion from pricing -> signup, click on calculator, and inbound leads routed to Sales Ops tag. keep it lightweight.

dom: who owns copy for tier names? we tested 'Core / Scale / Enterprise' last quarter and it underperformed. suggest testing 'Developer / Production / Enterprise' — clearer signal to eng teams.

mike: +1 to Developer/Production labels. also propose a 2-line microcopy under each tier: "Built for X" 

nina: for calculator, let's add an option for 'committed usage' to show savings. keep autofill examples for a 50k token/mo workload.

beth_cs: can CS handle the inbound routing? we can auto-tag leads that select Dedicated/Private with "enterprise-interest" and kick to Zendesk form and Sales Ops queue.

alejandra: @beth_cs yes pls. what about webinars? thinking 20-min demo + 10-min Q&A. host = rachel + dom on product, sam on pricing talk track. date options: Tue 2/14 or Thu 2/16.

rachel: prefer Thu 2/16. i can write the registration page copy. add a short benchmark narrative: "real customers cut inference unit cost 3x using batching + cache" — need an anonymized stat.

sam: i have a bench we can use: internal test showing 2.8x unit cost reduction on long-tail prompts. i'll draft the blurb and hand to legal for anonymization.

dom: for launch posts: staggered approach — 1) blog post with benchmark narrative + product update, 2) short linkedin / x thread highlighting new tier names and calculator, 3) webinar signup link. spacing of 48-72h between posts.

mike: tracking tags: utm=pricing-experiment, campaign=pricing-relaunch, variant=A/B (tiernames). add experiment id for analytics.

alejandra: checklist items -> pair ownership: copy (rachel), dev impl for calc + UX (mike), CS routing (beth_cs), legal signoff (nina), blog draft (dom), webinar ops (sam). who's got time to pair with mike on the calculator integration?

rachel: i can pair Wed morning for microcopy + FAQ strings.

mike: wed am works. i'll push a lightweight react widget with example payload. proto payload: ```json
{
  "monthly_tokens": 50000,
  "commitment": "none",
  "tier": "Developer"
}
```

beth_cs: CS will map inbound fields to Zendesk ticket tags. will need the final field list by Thu EOD.

nina: legal needs the benchmark blurb and the anonymized numbers. sam pls drop the test doc in google drive and i'll review.

sam: will share doc by EOD today. note: bench used g4dn-ish hardware; i'll generalize to "GPU-optimized serving" so it's not cloud-specific.

alejandra: micro-timelines: Wed AM pair on calc + FAQ strings, Thu morning final copy review, Thu noon legal signoff, Thu 4pm soft publish to staging, Fri morning soft email to beta customers, Mon webinar promo and registration open.

dom: can we also include a short in-product banner on /console for accounts likely to benefit? Product team needs a 2-day lead.

mike: i need the banner copy + CTA. rachel can you draft 1-liner?

rachel: "New pricing page experiments: clearer tiers and an interactive calculator — try the estimator" short CTA: "Try estimator"

deploy-bot: Reminder: Please add deploy tag `pricing-experiment/v1` to staging release notes when publishing.

alejandra: final asks: keep A/B test for tier names live for 3 weeks, then close + evaluate. Sam to own evaluation deck, dom to write the blog, rachel to run webinar copy and posts, beth_cs to own inbound routing. any blockers?

nina: none from legal once sam shares doc.

beth_cs: will need a mapping doc for fields; i can reuse existing inbound form schema.

alejandra: great — i'll turn this into a short runbook and ping engineering + product channels. thanks everyone :raised_hands:

sam: adding follow-up: please capture funnel events: pricing_page_view, calculator_open, calculator_submit, lead_tagged. we'll instrument them as part of the experiment.

mike: noted. setting up event schema now.

alejandra: closing thread with next check-in Wed 10:00am PT.
